rejected_rule.statement: A natural guardian of a minor cannot execute a lease of the minor's immovable property for more than one month without prior sanction from the Court.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "In Mustapha Lebbe v. Martinus [1 (1903)6 N. L. R. 364.], Layard C.J. observed 'It is a clear principle of Roman-Dutch Law that a minor's immovable property cannot be alienated without a decree of a Court of competent jurisdiction.'"
